reason: A session-memory plugin that maintains a project MEMORY.md index, provides session wrap-up reminders and markers, scaffolds memory files, and exposes graphical configuration; its primary purpose is memory and context management.

summaries.zh: 用于维护项目会话记忆索引、提供收尾提醒与状态标记，并通过图形化面板配置记忆相关设置的 DSH 插件。
summaries.en: A DSH plugin for maintaining a project session-memory index, providing wrap-up reminders and status markers, and configuring memory settings through a graphical panel.

capabilities: Injects a project memory index at session start
Creates and maintains MEMORY.md and memory/_TEMPLATE.md files
Writes session completion status markers under the configured state directory
Installs a user-level auto-memory skill template
Provides a graphical settings panel and HTTP configuration routes
